text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This... wasn't a historical novel, but a 
fantasy novel inspired by history, wasn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this great archmage behaving 
like a general has something to do with 
the historical figure she's based on...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Her instructions are precise and easy 
to understand. She has the aura of a 
leader, yet she's so gentle..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My... she has charisma as well. On top of 
that, she's kind, courageous, and 
broad-minded...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It's so similar... I wonder what 
choice the Trai... n-no, the Archmage... 
will make from here on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely absorbed by the captivating 
protagonist, Still in Love ended up 
skipping her training...
